Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

Adult Indian groom, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, slender adult oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, thick dark eyebrows, smooth clean-shaven cheeks and chin, swept wavy black hair with a prominent side part and raised quiff, small relaxed smile. No moustache or beard. Natural adult proportions, not a child. An olive travel jacket over an ivory shirt, dark trousers and tan walking shoes; a fine gold chain. Keep the same face and swept quiff throughout.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
At a different mountain-road pullout above the waterfall, the groom stands full-length in the LEFT third, about 62 percent of frame height, feet and quiff inside generous margins. He ALREADY stands outside the empty parked car, feet planted on fixed gravel marks, elbow resting on its CLOSED door, folded unmarked map held still. All tires touch the same stones; no driver or occupant. Never imply arriving, parking or getting out. The car occupies only the lower left; open cliffs and descending switchbacks spread behind him. His travel jacket and shirt move slightly in the breeze. On the RIGHT floats pearl-white editorial lettering, exactly 'Sri.' on a small first line and 'Ashok Kumar' on two large graceful lines. Bright beveled edges, mild halos and tiny moving glints, with no physical title support. Dark green pines on a distant slope give text contrast without enclosing the scene. Strong diagonal shafts arrive from upper left through valley mist; backlit grass seeds and tiny pollen motes hang at three depths. The uphill road visibly climbs toward a lone wind-shaped tree at a higher photo spot, establishing the next destination. No bride in this portrait; no extra text on car or map.
